However, less critical content, such as full-length videos, may be stored on servers farther away, resulting in longer loading times.

Each deflection you land bumps up their posture bar. When their bar is full, you can get a deathblow.

You don't have to empty their health bar. Just get their posture bar full and go for the deathblow.

So don't follow their advice.

A local admin account should have zero network access rights and and be locked to one machine only.

People don't need admin perms to install printers or any device for that matter. 

You can deploy a gpo flagging certain classes of devices for install without a user having admin rights. This let's the average standard user install certain kinds of hardware and can remove 99% of call volume for this sort of thing.
